title: Padding in Pagination stops working after update  2.3->2.6.3

comments.body: might be related to #2741. The tests are still passing though, which is weird 🤔
Any version before 2.6.0 will not have this error, so you could use those as a workaround. Thanks for reporting this @SchmidtDawid !

We don't pass the `padding` to the connector in the widget.

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/f5d1ab1bcd422ae8298dfd95ca8a617385025a59/src/widgets/pagination/pagination.js#L192
